LBR.note: Only a general LTA commitment to consumer protection; no rule or body stated.
Document states no rural programme or rural-urban figures; only a general aim to extend coverage.

facts.fact: The LTA granted Starlink a provisional one-year licence to operate in Liberia in 2024, per the LTA release.
LTA commissioners said new regulatory steps allow Starlink to operate as a nationwide retailer, with kits to be sold through electronics and telecom outlets across the country.
